films.line_en: Live above the city, every day.
films.desc_en: A high-energy vertical teaser showcasing a luxury penthouse with sweeping views over Skopje and Mount Vodno.
films.music: Upbeat electronic luxury house, deep bass, driving rhythm, 120 bpm
vo_mk: Искуси го Скопје од твојот нов луксузен дом.

shots.kf: Vertical portrait composition. A sleek, matte black espresso machine sits on a white marble kitchen island, centered. Behind it, large floor-to-ceiling windows reveal a blurred, golden-hour view of the Skopje skyline and Mount Vodno. Cinematic side lighting, 50mm lens, warm amber and charcoal color palette, highly photorealistic.
shots.motion: Thick espresso pours smoothly into a modern glass cup. The camera slowly pushes in towards the cup.

shots.kf: Vertical portrait composition. A luxurious, deep-textured cream modular sofa is centered in a high-end minimalist living room. The afternoon sun casts long, dramatic shadows across the hardwood floor. In the background, modern art elements blend with soft beige walls. 35mm lens, natural diffused lighting, neutral earth tones, photorealistic.
shots.motion: Dust motes dance in the sunbeams as the camera slowly tilts up from the floor to the sofa.

shots.kf: Vertical portrait composition. A sleek glass balcony railing in sharp focus in the foreground, centered. Beyond it, a breathtaking panoramic view of Skopje at twilight, with city lights just turning on and the Millennium Cross faintly glowing on the mountain. 24mm lens, deep depth of field, cool blue and warm gold palette, photorealistic.
shots.motion: The camera glides smoothly forward over the balcony edge while the city lights twinkle softly in the distance.

films.line_mk: Квалитет кој се гледа и чувствува.
films.line_en: Quality that is seen and felt.
films.desc_en: A calm, architectural exploration of premium apartment features, highlighting smart design and high-quality materials.
films.music: Ambient acoustic, soft piano and warm strings, relaxing, 85 bpm
vo_mk: Секој детаљ во нашите станови е внимателно дизајниран за вашиот комфор.
Користиме само врвни материјали кои гарантираат долготрајност и елеганција.
Паметните системи ви овозможуваат целосна контрола на светлината и топлината.
Пространите тераси нудат совршен поглед кон реката Вардар и градот.
Вашиот нов дом е оаза на мирот во срцето на Скопје.

shots.kf: Horizontal wide composition. A macro view of premium interior finishes: a slab of textured grey slate resting against rich, warm walnut wood paneling. Soft, diffused morning light highlights the natural grain and stone textures. 85mm macro lens, shallow depth of field, earthy browns and cool greys, highly photorealistic.
shots.motion: The camera slowly pans horizontally across the textures, revealing the subtle reflections on the wood.

shots.kf: Horizontal wide composition. A sleek, minimal, circular smart thermostat mounted on a smooth, matte beige wall. The screen glows softly with an ambient orange light, indicating warmth, without any readable text. 50mm lens, soft indoor lighting, warm and cozy color palette, photorealistic.
shots.motion: The ambient glow of the device gently pulses brighter as the camera slowly pushes in.

shots.kf: Horizontal wide composition. A spacious, minimalist master bedroom featuring a low-profile king bed with crisp white linens. Floor-to-ceiling windows take up the right side of the frame. Soft morning light enters the room. 24mm lens, wide angle, bright and airy color palette of whites and soft greys, photorealistic.
shots.motion: Sleek, automated sheer roller blinds smoothly glide upwards, revealing the bright morning sky outside. The camera is static.

shots.kf: Horizontal wide composition. A luxurious modern bathroom vanity featuring a floating oak double sink cabinet and brushed brass faucets. An oversized frameless mirror reflects a freestanding oval bathtub. Natural light streams from a frosted skylight. 35mm lens, clean lines, warm gold and crisp white palette, photorealistic.
shots.motion: The camera slowly tracks sideways from left to right, capturing the gleam of the brass fixtures.

shots.kf: Horizontal wide composition. An expansive open-plan living area. A dark oak dining table sits beneath a modern, geometric matte-black chandelier. In the background, a minimalist kitchen with handle-less charcoal cabinets. Large windows reveal a bright, overcast sky over Skopje. 24mm lens, deep focus, sophisticated dark and light contrast, photorealistic.
shots.motion: The camera performs a slow, smooth dolly forward towards the dining table, emphasizing the spaciousness.

shots.kf: Horizontal wide composition. A wide, curved terrace featuring a modern outdoor lounge chair and a small olive tree in a terracotta pot. Beyond the glass balustrade, the Vardar river winds through the city of Skopje under a clear blue midday sky. 35mm lens, bright sunlight, vibrant blues and greens, photorealistic.
shots.motion: The leaves of the olive tree rustle gently in a light breeze as the camera slowly pans left.

shots.kf: Horizontal wide composition. The striking, contemporary facade of a new luxury apartment building in Skopje. The architecture features staggered balconies with lush cascading greenery and sleek wooden louvers against white concrete. Clear blue sky background. 50mm lens, architectural photography style, crisp and high-contrast color palette, photorealistic.
shots.motion: The camera slowly tilts down the facade of the building, highlighting the architectural geometry and greenery.
